phase9_genomic.reason: No genomic data is present in this project's datasets. The five source files (cohort, demographics, labs, microbial_resistance, prior_med) were audited column by column and contain no sequence, gene, mutation or AMR-marker field. The resistance model is therefore phenotype-based only and makes no genomic claims.
phase9_genomic.how_to_enable: Provide a CSV at the path above with columns `order_proc_id_coded, marker` (one row per detected marker, e.g. AMRFinderPlus / ResFinder / CARD-RGI output), or set the GENOTYPE_TABLE_PATH environment variable to point at one. This module and the application will activate automatically; no other code changes are needed.
phase9_genomic.reference_note: Curated from the NCBI Reference Gene Catalog, CARD and ResFinder. Demonstration subset for a research prototype — not a validated AMR detection pipeline. Genotype does not equal phenotype; confirm with antimicrobial susceptibility testing.
